reportInfo.advisorTitle: Academic Advisor, Department of Land Economy University of Cambridge
reportInfo.deanComments:
Ms. Yuling Shu embodies the highest standards in our Faculty of Land Economy. Majoring in economics and accounting with a law minor, she graduated First Class as valedictorian.
Her achievements include scholarships, Journal of Accounting and Economics publication, ICAEW Prize, and Gates Cambridge Scholarship. Yuqi excels in financial reporting, economic theory, and regulatory applications.
She combines brilliance with maturity and scholarly passion. The Faculty fully endorses her for elite graduate programmes or leadership in finance and law.
reportInfo.advisorComments:
I have advised Ms. Yuling Shu in the Department of Land Economy at Cambridge for three years. She has demonstrated exceptional rigour, achieving First Class Honours as cohort top in economics, accounting, and corporate law modules.
Her dissertation integrating macroeconomics with forensic accounting and regulation was publishable, earning Marshall Society Prize nomination. Yuqi contributes proactively to research on IFRS standards and presents confidently in seminars.
She ranks in the top 1% of students I have supervised. I recommend her unreservedly for postgraduate study or professional roles.
reportInfo.recommendations:
Yuqi Shu is an outstanding candidate, among the best undergraduates in my experience. Her mastery of economics, accounting, and legal frameworks—proven by top rankings, prizes, publications, and scholarships—ideally suits her for leading MPhil/PhD programmes or roles in investment banking, consulting, or Big Four firms.
She has exceptional analytical depth, research ability, and leadership potential. I recommend her with highest enthusiasm and no reservations.
Contact me for further details.

improvementAreas.recommendation: Attend the Cambridge Union or Marshall Society presentation workshops to further refine public speaking and debate skills for conference presentations and professional interviews.
Join alumni mentoring programmes through the Cambridge Careers Service and attend finance/economics networking events to build connections in investment banking and consulting sectors.
